author: robin-dev
title: Return expiring receipt download URLs through the API
body:
## Scope

Return a 15-minute download URL for each receipt document through `GET /v1/transactions/:id/receipts`.

## Motivation

API integrations can see a Transaction's receipts but can't fetch the files.

## Risk and rollout

**Door:** one-way, published API contract

- A missing original or a storage failure fails the whole listing with a 500. No partial results or nullable links are returned. The test "fails the whole listing when a file can't be signed" covers it.
- Before release, check that the deployed credentials allow the full 15 minutes.

linkedIssue.body: API callers get a direct download URL, valid for 15 minutes, for every receipt file on a Transaction they can see. A Transaction with no receipts returns an empty list.
